data.name: WinWinWin
data.detailed_description:
Ready to Make Your Neighbors Call the Cops?​ 🚨

WINWINWIN​ is a Vocal Cord Weightlifting Simulator!​ Ditch those boring mouse and keyboard controls—in this game, your throat is the only weapon.

Core Gameplay: Brutally Simple!

  • Find Your Rival:​ Randomly match with an online "arch-nemesis" or drag your "frenemy" into the arena.

  • Inhale Deeply:​ Once the game starts, scream "WINWINWIN"​ at the top of your lungs into the microphone!

  • Volume = Power:​ The system uses real-time dynamic detection to convert your decibels directly into on-screen progress bars.

  • Claim Victory:​ In a heart-pounding 30 seconds, whoever is louder and lasts longer fills their bar first and is crowned the "King of Lungs!"

✨ Game Features:

  • All-Star "Loudmouth" Roster:​ Control absurd animal characters (the majestic Bald Eagle, the chill Polar Bear, and other mysterious guests) as they vibrate wildly in sync with your screams.

  • Physics Engine? Nope!​ Experience pure soundwave vibration feedback that makes it feel like the whole room is shaking.

  • Taunt System:​ Built-in goofy expressions and sound effects designed to crush your opponent's spirit while you're ahead.

  • Streamer's Dream:​ Perfect for content creators. Viewers can bet via live chat on who is the true "Human Amplifier."

⚠️ Friendly Warning:​ Settle your pets before playing. Turn off noise suppression software. Ensure your microphone won't shatter from the blast. This isn't just a competition; it's a war of lung capacity. Do you dare to accept the challenge?

data.short_description: WINWINWIN​ is a chaotic real-time voice battler! Two players scream into their mics. First to max out their bar in 30 seconds wins! Command quirky animal avatars in this button-free brawl. it's pure vocal mayhem for streamers and friends. No skills needed—just lungs of steel! How loud can you roar?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows7
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or AMD Athlon 64 X2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphics card supporting DirectX 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound card compatible with DirectX
  • Additional Notes: A microphone device is required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any integrated graphics card or discrete graphics card that supports DirectX 1
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound card compatible with DirectX
  • Additional Notes: A microphone device is required
